P0000.rationale: P0000 converts an existing prose caveat ('unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name') into an explicit qualification edge qualifying C0003. The source text directly supports the exception to the prohibition against continuing to use a previous name, the target baseline C0003 is the exact duty qualified, and all fields accurately reflect the text.

quotes: If there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel, a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name;
P0001.rationale: The source provides a discretionary authorization ('a limited-validity passport may be issued') rather than an automatic exception that excuses the mandatory suspension under C0005. If adjudicators do not exercise the discretion to issue a limited-validity passport, the obligation to suspend the application to request acceptable ID remains in force. Furthermore, this provision is already captured as a permission in C0006; adding an exception record mischaracterizes permissive issuance as an outright waiver of duty and creates a duplicate record.
